events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
Under NS-0 the cancellation-fee branch is fixed by who cancelled: the driver cancelled [F4], and the driver's stated reason is rider no-show [F13], so the case is tested under NS-1/NS-2 rather than NS-4 [NS-0][NS-1].

NS-1 requires the driver to have indicated arrival and waited more than three minutes at the pickup. The timeline shows the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 18:22:50 while 41 m from the pickup point [F6], which satisfies the arrival precondition (a residual inconsistency in the record — F7 saying the tap is null — is contradicted by the timeline record F6, and system records govern) [NS-1]. GPS places the driver within 200 m from 18:21:00, with 5 min 15 s cumulative time inside the radius before cancellation, and stationary for 4 min 10 s ending exactly at the cancellation [F2][F3]. Measured from the tap, the driver stayed inside the radius 3 min 50 s until cancelling, i.e. more than 3 minutes [F6]; measured from the platform-recorded arrival at 18:21:00, the driver cancelled 5 min 40 s later [F5]. Both exceed the 3:01 threshold, so all three NS-1 conditions hold and the $6.61 cancellation fee stands [NS-1].

The rider's message asking for "2 more minutes" at 18:24 [F11] does not create an exemption: the policy grants no grace extension on rider request, and the driver in fact waited on past that point before cancelling at 18:26:40 [F12][F4]. Heavy rain [F16] and moderate traffic on Maxwell Road (band 3, 20–29 km/h) [F14][F15] are not conditions attaching to the cancellation-fee rule, and there is no ETA-based free-cancellation rule in Ryde policy; the rider's remedy would have been a manual appeal within 30 days at most [NS-7]. The fee is $6.61 as recorded [F4][F8], unaffected by the 1.0× surge [F9].

No account flag attaches: because no refund is due and no RD-1 breach is recorded, RD-6's precondition is not met, and the driver's profile (1 prior no-show upheld [F18]) cannot be used to decide this case or to add an action on its own [RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your dispute didn't change the outcome: the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and no refund is due. Two facts decided it — your driver arrived and waited at the pickup for more than three minutes before cancelling, and asking for two extra minutes doesn't pause or extend that three-minute wait rule. Nothing else, including the rain and traffic, changes the fee. No action is being taken on your account. You can still appeal manually within 30 days if you wish, and any payment owed to you would come as a Ryde voucher rather than cash.

DRIVER: The cancellation outcome went your way: the $6.61 cancellation fee is upheld and paid to you as a Ryde voucher. Two facts decided it — you tapped "I'm Here" at the pickup and remained there longer than the three-minute wait, and the rider's request for two more minutes doesn't extend that wait rule. Rain and traffic don't affect this rule. No action is taken on your account: one earlier no-show finding on your profile was not used to decide this case and adds nothing here.
